annotation.title_clean: France 2030 : 3 nouveaux dispositifs lancés pour faire de la France la pionnière de l'IA et de la robotique
annotation.title_en: France 2030: 3 new schemes launched to make France the pioneer of AI and robotics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique
annotation.summary_en: French government press release (13 June 2025) announcing three France 2030 schemes on AI-robotics convergence: a €30M CNRS-led robotics research programme, a call for expressions of interest on "robotics and intelligent machines", and a forthcoming "AI Pioneer" funding scheme. Also mentions the military Pendragon project and funded projects.
key_provisions_or_claims: €30M robotics acceleration research programme piloted by CNRS
AMI 'Robotique et machine intelligente' for collaborative R&D on AI-native robotics (efficient, robust, modular, user-friendly)
Forthcoming 'Pionnier de l'IA' funding scheme with intelligent robotics as priority target
Pendragon defence project on collective intelligence across robotic platforms
Funding for Spider solar-panel cleaning robot and LOGIE AI generative-AI robots project
